text:
To resolve the `Permission denied` errors on `/opt/data/config.yaml` when running on NAS devices like UGOS Pro, you need to remap the container's user permissions to match your host user.

Pass the **`PUID`** and **`PGID`** (or **`HERMES_UID`** and **`HERMES_GID`**) environment variables when running your Docker container. 

For example:
```bash
docker run -it \
  -e PUID=$(id -u) \
  -e PGID=$(id -g) \
  -v /path/to/host/data:/opt/data \
  nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest
```

This ensures the container maps its file access permissions to your NAS host's user/group IDs rather than causing permission conflicts with the host filesystem.
